# Chanh's Personal Website Project

This is a Vue.js personal website/portfolio project built with Vite for fast development and modern tooling.

## Project Structure
- **Vue 3**: Using Composition API and Options API
- **Vite**: Fast build tool and development server
- **Single File Components**: All components use scoped styles
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first approach with CSS Grid and Flexbox

## Coding Standards
- Use semantic HTML elements
- Follow Vue.js best practices and style guide
- Implement responsive design patterns
- Use modern CSS features (Grid, Flexbox, custom properties)
- Keep components modular and reusable
- Use descriptive component and variable names

## Component Guidelines
- Each section of the website is a separate component
- Use scoped styles to avoid CSS conflicts
- Implement smooth animations and transitions
- Ensure accessibility with proper ARIA labels and semantic markup
- Optimize for performance and loading speed
